periods.analysis: Q1 actions: The study scope was approved, but no analyst was assigned until March. Pulled a list of dental clinics and their service hours. Partners: Harborview Community Health Center.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Map dental clinics against travel time and open talks with the Community Health Center on mobile services.

periods.analysis: Q2 actions: Early travel-time maps show Dune Avenue and Seagrove residents face the longest trips. Held a first meeting with the Community Health Center about a mobile dental van, with no commitment yet. Partners: Harborview Community Health Center, Harborview Unified School District.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Finish the travel-time map and hold follow-up meetings on a mobile dental van.

periods.analysis: Q3 actions: Mapped dental clinics against travel time and found that residents in Dune Avenue and Seagrove face the longest trips. Met twice with Harborview Community Health Center on a mobile dental van but have no site or funding commitment yet. Partners: Harborview Community Health Center, Harborview Unified School District.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Submit a grant request for a mobile unit, and test a quarterly school-based sealant day at one elementary school to show demand.
